Wasn't good. One weird experience.
Jun 2019 • Family
Wanted a good treat for the birthday boy - ordered their 42-day dry-aged beef. It costed us about 50% more than what we had at Stoker, but because we had such fond memories of dry-aged beef and we read such awesome reviews of this place, we just had to give it a try despite the much higher price.

The steak looked pretty good on arrival, but man, it was tough. Tough to cut through, extremely tough to swallow. I had wanted to forgo the steak after two bites but my kind husband took it all. Pretty disappointed since it was totally opposite of what a good dry-aged beef should be. It was really quite a bad kind of surprise for us. And the weirdest part of it all? The owner and his two sons were seated right beside us in this two-table restaurant having their lunch with almost exactly the same food ordered as us. We knew he was the owner because he went in and out of the restaurant several times, giving instructions to the lady server of what needs to be done. They waited as long as us, about 40 minutes for our simple sides and finally the steak. After hearing our shock and comments regarding the steak's toughness, the owner asked his younger son in Vietnamese if the meat was tough, and his innocent young son answered in perfect English that, "yeah, it's kinda chewy...". The owner stormed out. I wonder if he went looking for the chef.

The lady server was sweet, urging us to order the set lunch's beef bowl since it will probably arrive sooner and perhaps more appropriate for our young daughter who was famished by 2pm and honestly feeling rather hot in the (too) mildly air-conditioned restaurant. Sadly, the beef bowl arrived slightly later than the other dishes we ordered, and the beef was done medium rare, in fact it looked 90% rare with blood spilling on the rice beneath --- too bloody for a 5 year-old to enjoy. So she only ate sides that day.

Overall, I'm just too weirded out to return.

Pleasantly surprised! ❤️❤️❤️
May 2019 • Solo
I've been passing by this neighborhood joint for quite some time now...not being able to find time to try it until today! Very pleasantly surprised! Lunch menu offers very good value for money...

Started with cream of asparagus. Very light and foamy. Very tasty especially when finished with the slightly charred pieces of baguette.

The steak was quite tender. It is a second cut, but nonetheless, still very tender as it was sous vide steak. Grilled veggies were ok, tad too much balsamic reduction for my taste.

The pumpkin pudding to end the meal...is just AMAZING! ❤️❤️❤️ Perfectly pairs with the slightly tart peach.

Not cheap, but great VALUE.

Excellent Meal
Feb 2019 • Family
Our meal at Sol Butcherant in Phu My Hung, District 7 was fantastic. We all had the set lunch (3 courses for 195 VND or ~8.50 USD). This was comprised of Asparagus soup, a seasonal salad, and sous vide and seared Back Onyx beef, with 63 degree egg, and Japanese steamed rice. While the soup and salad were very tasty, the highlight was the beef which was perfectly cooked, and had amazing texture and flavor. The staff also served us a wonderful chocolate mousse dessert on the house, for a perfect, sweet finish to a great dining experience.
